scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js'))){require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','src/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'});}for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dashboard').filter(x=>x.endsWith('.js'))){require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','dashboard/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'});}console.log('JavaScript syntax checks passed.');"
